subject: Instrumentation starter bundle — pricing, pilot, and SKU ask
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soren Hsu <soren@brightway.ai>, AppNexus Health Procurement <procurement@appnexushealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Instrumentation starter bundle — pricing, pilot, and SKU ask

Hi Soren / procurement —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I put together a compact \"Instrumentation Starter\" offer that bundles retention (30-day hot + 12-month cold), tracing (100k traces/day baseline), and two advanced dashboards oriented to clinical ops and billing analytics. Attached is a one-page summary and a sample pilot SOW.

Quick notes up front:
- Starter bundle list price: $15k/month for the baseline configuration (includes 100k traces/day, 1TB hot retention, 12TB cold annual archive).
- Pilot option (90 days): we can convert to a 50% pilot concession on list for the first quarter in exchange for an onboarding commitment and a short case study.
- Metering: traces and storage are metered; the bundle provides credits that cover typical first-90-day spikes. Overages billed monthly.

Questions for you to help us size the pilot:
1) Expected average traces/day during the pilot window (ballpark).
2) Any regulatory constraints on storage location or KMS?
3) Primary success metrics — cost/latency targets, dashboard adoption, or regression detection?

Next steps I propose: quick confirmation of the pilot sizing, we’ll send a draft SOW + pricing SKUs, and Karthik (cc'd) can propose the technical support cadence.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: observability-starter-bundle-v1.pdf (one-page summary)
Attachment: pilot-sow-templates.docx (SOW skeleton)

From: Soren Hsu <soren@brightway.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AppNexus Health Procurement <procurement@appnexushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Instrumentation starter bundle — pricing, pilot, and SKU ask

Jordan —

Thanks for this, looks promising. A few clarifying items from our side before we lock sizing:
- Traces/day: we average ~60k traces/day currently across production and can spike to ~180k during batch windows.
- Storage/retention: our compliance team requires EU storage for some PHI-adjacent logs; can you confirm region placement options?
- Pilot success metrics: we want to validate (a) 30% token-cost savings from intelligent caching, (b) <120ms 95th percentile dashboard load for clinical dashboards, and (c) no impact to PII redaction jobs.

Procurement: what is the minimal invoicing SKU for a pilot? We prefer a single invoice line for observability with a pilot discount applied rather than multiple metered lines to simplify approvals.

Soren
Soren Hsu
Head of Platform Engineering, Brightway.ai
soren@brightway.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soren Hsu <soren@brightway.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Instrumentation starter bundle — pricing, pilot, and SKU ask

Hi Soren —

Appreciate the detail. Short answers and concrete proposal below.

1) Region: we can host the data in EU for the PHI-adjacent logs (we'll surface an EU tenant for storage and KMS). That does add a minor surcharge for cross-region replication if you do global read traffic; we'll keep replication off for the pilot unless you ask.

2) Pilot SKU recommendation (simple single-line invoice approach):
- SKU: RDW-OBS-STARTER-PILOT
- Description: 90-day pilot — includes 100k trace baseline, 1TB hot retention, 12-month cold archive credits, 2 advanced dashboards, onboarding and 3 support check-ins.
- Pilot list: $12,000/month. Pilot concession: 50% off first 90 days -> $6,000/month for pilot.
- Overages: any traces above the credit are billed at $0.00008/trace (we'll apply burst detection and alerting before billing). Cold archive overage: $0.02/GB/month.

Operational proposals:
- Success metrics: we’ll instrument dashboard load times and cache hit-rate. If we do not meet the <120ms 95th target, we will commit two technical days at no charge to optimize dashboards.
- Cost-savings validation: we'll include a simple eval harness to estimate token savings from KV caching; you’ll get a weekly report showing projected monthly savings if the pilot were scaled to production.

Legal/commercial notes:
- We can provide a short SOW and a single invoice line for procurement. Our commercial team prefers to keep metering visible in the invoice as an appendix (for later conversion to metered billing), but procurement's request for a single pilot line is acceptable.
- We can do the pilot under a short Work Order via DocuSign. Shoehorned changes (e.g., SLA exceptions) would require an amendment.

Next steps I suggest: Jordan — send the RDW-OBS-STARTER-PILOT draft SKU + SOW to procurement; Soren — confirm pilot start window (we typically need 7 business days for onboarding).

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: pilot-sow-templates.docx (SOW skeleton referenced)

From: Soren Hsu <soren@brightway.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AppNexus Health Procurement <procurement@appnexushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Instrumentation starter bundle — pricing, pilot, and SKU ask

Karthik / Jordan —

This looks good and aligns with our procurement constraints. We accept the 90-day pilot at the $6k/month concession and the single-line invoice approach. Two small asks before onboarding:
1) Please include an explicit clause in the SOW that the pilot will not auto-convert to a paid subscription without express written approval from AppNexus Health procurement.
2) Send the exact invoice PO lines we can drop into our AP system (SKU, quantity=1, unit price, tax handling, and billing contact).

If you can turn those around by end of week, we can kick off onboarding the week of Oct 4.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Soren
Head of Platform Engineering | Brightway.ai
